I got one bag of fertilizer from the subsidy depot this year, and I will put it all on this maize plot because it is my main field and I need the cobs to feed my family. I will also spread goat manure like I have always done, and I will plant the hybrid seed they gave me because my sister’s crop did well with it last season. I do not buy chemicals for food crops — they cost too much — and I have no money to hire workers, so my daughter and I will do all the work when the rains come. We never irrigate here; we wait for the rains from God.
